title: Keep it moving
text: Where does your next pass go?
tip: Check the runner and who is covering them. If the run is covered, look for the simple pass.

options.text: Hit it long over the top
options.why: It gets the ball forward, but the covering player is well placed to win it.

options.text: Slide it through for the run
options.why: The run was covered, so the pass goes straight to them.

options.text: Play it short to the side
options.why: The look showed the runner was covered and a mate alone to the side. Keep it and go again.

scan.prompt: The ball is at your feet in the middle. Look up before you pass it.
